title: Malibu Swing Set
current_description:
The Malibu is two play structures joined together. An elevated clubhouse with expansive windows and a wooden peak roof sits at one end, a raised playhouse with saloon-style doors and a play kitchen at the other, and a wrap-around porch with a wooden staircase runs between them. Each has its own kid-friendly step ladder, so children can get into either one without going through the other.
The play kitchen inside the playhouse has a toy stovetop and sink. A 10-foot wave slide drops back to the ground, and the beam holds two belt swings and a trapeze, so several kids can swing at once. Two shaded sandbox areas sit below the decks, with sand not included. Backyard Discovery covers the set with a 5-year warranty.
current_excerpt: Backyard Discovery's Malibu joins an elevated clubhouse and a raised playhouse by staircase, with a 10-foot wave slide and two sandbox areas below.
source_facts:
Get ready for a playground experience like no other with the epic Malibu Swing Set from Backyard Discovery. This extraordinary wooden swing set transforms outdoor play with an elevated clubhouse and playhouse connected by a magical staircase, inviting children into a world of imagination and excitement. Two kid-friendly step ladders provide easy access to both the clubhouse and playhouse, each featuring charming wooden peak roofs and breezy windows that capture the essence of a coastal retreat. The adorable playhouse welcomes little ones with saloon-style doors, revealing a delightful play kitchen complete with a toy stovetop and sink. This cozy play space recreates the charm of a real mini home, where children can immerse themselves in imaginative role-play. A wrap-around porch with a wooden staircase leads to the large clubhouse with expansive windows, offering a breezy beach-style haven perfect for planning adventures and outdoor hangouts. The 10-foot wave slide offers exciting rides back to the ground, while two durable belt swings and a trapeze bar invite non-stop active play. Below, two sandbox areas are perfect for building sandcastles and embarking on treasure hunts. Crafted for ultimate fun, this outdoor playset is designed for kids of all ages to enjoy endless adventures.

title: Mount McKinley Swing Set
current_description:
The rock wall on the Mount McKinley is extra wide, with 9 holds and a rope assist, so two kids can climb to the deck at the same time instead of queuing. A rope ladder over 6 feet tall with wooden rungs gives a harder route up, and a flat step ladder gives an easier one for younger children.
The play deck sits under a brightly colored canopy roof and comes with a steering wheel and a toy telescope, and it stays open enough that you can see what is happening from across the yard. An 8-foot wave slide handles the way down, and the beam carries two belt swings and a trapeze. The shaded area below the deck takes sand, which is not included. It ships ready to assemble with guided BILT app instructions and a 5-year warranty.
current_excerpt: Backyard Discovery's Mount McKinley pairs an extra-wide 9-hold rock wall and rope assist with a tall rope ladder, an 8-foot wave slide and a sandbox space.

title: Shenandoah Swing Set
current_description:

Downstairs is a playhouse with a full front door, a play kitchen holding a toy cooktop, sink, and cordless play phone, and a side snack bar window that opens over an attached picnic table with bench seating. That table doubles as the spot for crafts when nobody is running a pretend cafe.
Kids reach the raised clubhouse, which has a wooden roof and windows, either by the rock wall with its 12 climbing holds or by the flat step ladder. The 10-foot wave slide handles the trip back down, and two belt swings and a trapeze bar let several kids swing at once. It is built from cedar, arrives ready to assemble with guided instructions in the BILT app, and carries a 5-year warranty.

title: Tacoma Falls Swing Set
current_description:
Tacoma Falls stacks two separate play spaces into one structure. The upper clubhouse has windows, a wooden roof, and a built-in chalkboard, with a crow's nest lookout and toy telescope above it. Two slides run down from that level, an enclosed spiral tube slide that twists on the way and a wave slide for a faster straight shot. A rock wall and a step ladder give kids two ways back up.
The lower playhouse has its own full front door and a play kitchen behind it, with a toy sink, a cookware set, a dinner bell, and battery-powered accessories. Two belt swings and a web disc swing hang alongside the structure.
Backyard Discovery builds the set from natural cedar and ships it ready to assemble, with guided instructions in the BILT app. It carries a 5-year warranty.

title: Tucson Swing Set

That lower area can be filled with sand to make a sandbox, though sand is not included.
Kids reach the deck by a rock wall with six holds that also works as a ladder, then take the 8-foot wave slide back down. Two belt swings and a trapeze bar round out the active play.
The cedar carries a burnt sienna finish, and pieces come pre-cut, pre-drilled, and pre-stained with guided setup in the BILT app. Backyard Discovery covers the set for 5 years.
